d: A Ukrainian drone strike has hit Russia's Slavyansk-on-Kuban oil refinery in the Krasnodar region, sparking fires and causing serious damage. The November 26 attack comes as the refinery was still undergoing repairs following a September strike. Meanwhile, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has warned of a possible fresh Russian attack, raising fears of another escalation in the ongoing war. As both sides intensify strikes on critical infrastructure, Russia's energy facilities remain a key target in Ukraine's drone campaign.
